node.title: Re: Need Fast LWP GET (updated)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Have a look at [Corion]'s [mod://Future::HTTP], it supports multiple backends that allow for asynchronous HTTP requests. Just note that the default backend, if none of the event loops could be found, is [mod://HTTP::Tiny], which is synchronous, so make sure to load (and start) one of the supported event loops.

Update: Now that [Corion] has released [mod://Future::HTTP] 0.14, you can use the is_async method to confirm that the requests will indeed be asynchronous, e.g. my $ua = Future::HTTP->new(); die "UA is not asynchronous" unless $ua->is_async;
